A formal meeting has three questions to answer clearly.

When the answers are clear before the meeting starts, members can focus on the decision instead of the process around it.

Who can take part?

Access, credentials, and eligibility are clear before participation begins.

What is being decided?

Members arrive with the agenda, materials, and context they need.

What will stand afterward?

Results, records, and next steps stay connected to the meeting.

Ontario Federation of Labour · 2025 convention

1,200 secure votes

Executive election results in under one minute.

At the OFL Convention, DOTS Connect processed nearly 1,200 votes for executive elections in under 60 seconds. Alongside the OPSEU/SEFPO BPS Conference and Divisionals, it helped keep two major union events clear and moving.

CUPE local partner · 2026 proposals

87% participation

Clear direction back to the bargaining table.

More than 250 members voted only on the department-specific proposals relevant to them, giving the executive a clear mandate to return to bargaining.
